statement: SDL reads feature 0x05 for gyro and acceleration calibration, ignores short reports and computes biases/scales from raw values when available; unlike the Linux driver, it does not require every calibration query to succeed in order to expose a joystick.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 555-647. Source-only fallback, not a physical sensor accuracy test.
